mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DIAGNOSIS_RESULT ( user_id, `year_month`, total_income, unmatched_income, total_expense, net_cash_flow, fixed_expense, fixed_expense_ratio, total_financial_assets, liquid_assets, safe_assets, calculated_at, finalized_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{yearMonth}, #{totalIncome}, #{unmatchedIncome}, #{totalExpense}, #{netCashFlow}, #{fixedExpense}, #{fixedExpenseRatio}, #{totalFinancialAssets}, #{liquidAssets}, #{safeAssets}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{finalizedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_income = IF(finalized_at IS NULL, VALUES(total_income), total_income), unmatched_income = IF(finalized_at IS NULL, VALUES(unmatched_income), unmatched_income), total_expense = IF(finalized_at IS NULL, VALUES(total_expense), total_expense), net_cash_flow = IF(finalized_at IS NULL, VALUES(net_cash_flow), net_cash_flow), fixed_expense = IF(finalized_at IS NULL, VALUES(fixed_expense), fixed_expense), fixed_expense_ratio = IF(finalized_at IS NULL, VALUES(fixed_expense_ratio), fixed_expense_ratio), total_financial_assets = IF(finalized_at IS NULL, VALUES(total_financial_assets), total_financial_assets), liquid_assets = IF(finalized_at IS NULL, VALUES(liquid_assets), liquid_assets), safe_assets = IF(finalized_at IS NULL, VALUES(safe_assets), safe_assets), calculated_at = IF(finalized_at IS NULL, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, calculated_at), finalized_at = IF(finalized_at IS NULL, VALUES(finalized_at), finalized_at)
